a prominent figure: As a prominent figure in the music industry, the singer is recognized by fans wherever she goes.
身為音樂界的知名人物，這位歌手走到哪裡都會被歌迷認出來。
play a prominent role: Social media can play a prominent role in elections, so candidates spend a lot of money on online ads.
社群媒體能在選舉中扮演重要角色，所以候選人花很多錢在網路廣告上。
a prominent position: The store put the new phones in a prominent position near the entrance so that every customer would notice them.
那家店把新手機擺在入口附近的顯眼位置，讓每位顧客都會注意到。
prominent features: Tall mountains and long coastlines are the most prominent features of Taiwan's landscape.
高山和綿長的海岸線是台灣地形最突出的特徵。
a prominent nose: The actor has a prominent nose that sticks out from his face, so cartoonists always draw it very big.
那位演員有個從臉上高高凸出的高挺鼻子，所以漫畫家總是把它畫得很大。
a promising start: The team made a promising start to the season, winning their first five games in a row.
這支球隊在本季有個好的開始，連贏了前五場比賽。
a promising young player: The coach believes Amy is a promising young player who could join the national team in a few years.
教練認為艾咪是位前途光明的年輕球員，幾年後可能入選國家隊。
promising results: The new medicine has shown promising results in early tests, giving hope that it may cure the disease in the future.
這種新藥在早期試驗中顯示出令人振奮的初步結果，讓人期待它未來可能治癒這種疾病。
look promising: The sky is clear and the forecast says sunny, so our plans for the beach look promising this weekend.
天空晴朗，氣象預報也說會是晴天，所以我們這週末去海邊的計畫看起來很有希望。
prompt action: Thanks to the firefighters' prompt action, the fire was put out within minutes and nobody was hurt.
多虧消防員迅速的行動，火在幾分鐘內就被撲滅，沒有人受傷。
a prompt reply: Thank you for your prompt reply; I received your email only an hour after I sent my question.
謝謝你迅速的回覆；我寄出問題才一個小時就收到你的信了。
be prompt in doing: Good shops are always prompt in answering complaints, so unhappy customers do not have to wait for days.
好的商店總是很迅速地回應客訴，所以不滿意的顧客不必等上好幾天。
prompt payment: The shop gives a small discount for prompt payment, so customers who pay within seven days save money.
那家店對即時付款給予小折扣，所以七天內付款的顧客可以省錢。
prompt someone to do: The heavy rain prompted many people to stay at home instead of going to the night market.
大雨促使許多人待在家裡，而不去夜市。
be prone to injury: Older athletes tend to be prone to injury, so they need more rest between games than young players.
年紀較大的運動員往往容易受傷，所以他們比年輕球員需要更多比賽間的休息。
accident-prone: My little brother is so accident-prone that he falls off his bike or cuts his finger almost every week.
我弟弟很容易出事，幾乎每週都會從腳踏車上摔下來或割傷手指。
be prone to exaggerate: Be careful with my uncle's stories; he can be prone to exaggerate, like saying his fish was as big as a car.
聽我叔叔的故事要小心；他容易誇大，像是說他釣到的魚跟車子一樣大。
error-prone: Typing long account numbers by hand is error-prone, so the bank now uses a scanner instead.
手動輸入長串帳號很容易出錯，所以銀行現在改用掃描器。
lie prone: The soldiers were ordered to lie prone on the ground, face down, so the enemy could not see them.
士兵們奉命臉朝下俯臥在地上，讓敵人看不見他們。
a prosperous business: His grandfather started with a tiny noodle stand and turned it into a prosperous business that made the family rich.
他祖父從一個小麵攤起家，把它變成讓全家致富的興旺生意。
a prosperous future: Many parents believe a good education will give their children a prosperous future with well-paid jobs.
許多父母相信良好的教育能給孩子一個有高薪工作的繁榮未來。
a prosperous nation: After decades of hard work and trade, the country became a prosperous nation with one of the highest incomes in Asia.
經過數十年的努力和貿易，這個國家成為亞洲收入最高之一的富強國家。
psychological warfare: During the war, both sides used psychological warfare, such as dropping leaflets, to make enemy soldiers lose hope.
戰爭期間，雙方都使用心理戰，例如空投傳單，讓敵軍士兵失去希望。
psychological pressure: Many senior high students feel strong psychological pressure from their parents' high expectations about exams.
許多高中生因為父母對考試的高度期望而感到強大的心理壓力。
a psychological barrier: For many runners, finishing a marathon in under three hours is a psychological barrier as much as a physical one.
對許多跑者來說，三小時內跑完馬拉松既是體能上的障礙，也是心理障礙。
psychological problems: Being bullied at school for a long time can lead to psychological problems such as depression and anxiety.
長期在學校被霸凌可能導致憂鬱和焦慮等心理問題。
a psychological thriller: The movie is a psychological thriller that plays with the audience's mind instead of relying on blood and violence.
這部電影是一部心理驚悚片，靠的是玩弄觀眾的心思，而不是血腥暴力。
pure luck: I didn't study at all, so passing the test was pure luck; I just guessed most of the answers.
我完全沒讀書，所以考試及格純粹是運氣；大部分答案我都是用猜的。
pure gold: This ring is made of pure gold, so it is much more expensive than the ones mixed with other metals.
這枚戒指是純金打造的，所以比混了其他金屬的戒指貴得多。
pure and simple: He failed the course because he was lazy, pure and simple; there is no other reason.
他這門課被當純粹就是因為懶惰；沒有其他原因。
pure science: Pure science aims to understand how nature works, while applied science uses that knowledge to solve practical problems.
純科學的目的在於了解大自然如何運作，而應用科學則用這些知識解決實際問題。
pure chance: We met by pure chance at the train station after not seeing each other for ten years.
我們十年沒見，卻純屬巧合地在火車站遇見了。
pure genius: Turning an old bus into a mobile library was pure genius; children in remote villages love it.
把舊公車改裝成行動圖書館真是天才之作；偏遠村落的孩子都很喜歡。
of pure heart: The old monk was a man of pure heart who never thought badly of anyone and helped everyone in need.
那位老和尚是個心地純潔的人，從不把人往壞處想，並幫助每個需要幫助的人。
